error[ZBX-E1015]: the Mac has no room for the virtual machine's disk
  while  preparing the virtual machine's disk
  cause  the Mac's volume has 700 MiB free; the machine needs 2048 MiB beside
         its disk
  path   /Users/ada/Library/Application Support/zbx/store.img
  fix    free space on the Mac's volume, then run the command again
  more   zbx explain E1015
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E1015.html
